559 -> 552: base can resolve every string it looks up. THREE OF THE TWENTY-ONE ARE MINE; ELEVEN OF THE RISE IS NOT.

base held 21 strings whose msgid the catalogue no longer carried -- 21 of the
tree's 573 -- so a Spanish reader hitting any of them got English, silently, and
nothing logged it. base/i18n/base.pot is re-exported and base's share is 0.

    odoo-bin i18n export -c p314o19m.conf -d <db> base

THE EXPORT HAS TO SEE EVERY MODULE, NOT EVERY INSTALLED MODULE. Run against a
database whose addons_path is the odoo checkout alone, the same command drops
1993 msgids -- module titles like "1099 Reporting" and "360 Feedback" come off
ir_module_module rows, and a database that has never listed enterprise or
agromarin has no such rows to export. base.pot demonstrably carries them, so the
export belongs on the full path. Taken against a fresh database created through
the live conf, which lists 1566 modules, it is +122 msgids and -76.

None of the 76 removals is a live string: each was grepped against every .py,
.xml and .csv under odoo/addons/base and none of them appears. One is
"An email is required for find_or_create to work" -- the pre-rename spelling of a
message this fork renamed to get_or_create, stranded in the catalogue since.
